qa.user_verbatim_complaint: 详情面板文件名超宽导致溢出
qa.complaint_resolution_evidence: Added numberOfLines={1} + ellipsizeMode='middle' to the filePath Text in SidebarFileView.tsx (lines 49-55) and CodexPatchView.tsx (line 119). Added flexShrink:1 to SidebarFileView's styles.filePath (line 224) so the Text yields to parent width. Removed obsolete U+200B zero-width-space insertion. Live DOM measurement confirms applied CSS properties: sidebar path elements have whiteSpace: 'nowrap', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', overflow: 'hidden' — the classic single-line truncation pattern.

qa.overall_assessment: PASS. Source fix is present (numberOfLines={1} + ellipsizeMode='middle' + flexShrink:1 in SidebarFileView.tsx lines 51-52 + 224; CodexPatchView.tsx line 119). Live DOM measurement of path-like elements confirms expected CSS properties (whiteSpace:'nowrap', textOverflow:'ellipsis', overflow:'hidden', fixed width 244px, scrollW===width). The detail panel rendered at 760px content width shows the tool Description 'Check spec size and manifest' (not the command). No horizontal overflow was observed.
